comparison.objective: Remove snapped filament from a printer extruder and discard it while restoring the tension lever.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a spring lever open while the other hand pulls a thin filament through the released drive nip.
comparison.success_condition: Filament is removed and placed in the tray, lever restored, and arms withdrawn; partial credit tracks extraction distance.
comparison.reason: Concurrent hold-and-pull shares generic bimanual coordination but lacks coaxial tool seating, screw adjustment, jam-nut countertorque, and retained-angle verification.
